# jsQR

`jsQR.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of jsQR 1.4.0 from
https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR (npm package `jsqr@1.4.0`). It is served from this
website and loaded only when a software QR decoder is needed. It does not upload
camera images or contact another service. See `jsQR-LICENSE.txt` for Apache-2.0.
